views.name: movie_actor_year
views.body_sql: SELECT m.MID AS movie_id, p.PID AS actor_id, m.year AS year, p.Gender AS actor_gender FROM Movie m JOIN M_Cast c ON m.MID = c.MID JOIN Person p ON c.PID = p.PID
views.description: Denormalized relation linking each movie to its associated actors, including the extracted year and actor gender.

views.name: year_movie_metrics
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    m.year,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.MID) AS total_movies,
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT m_exf.MID) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.MID) AS percentage_exclusively_female_actors
FROM Movie m
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT mc.MID
    FROM M_Cast mc
    JOIN Person p ON mc.PID = p.PID
    GROUP BY mc.MID
    HAVING MIN(p.Gender) = 'Female' AND MAX(p.Gender) = 'Female'
) m_exf ON m.MID = m_exf.MID
GROUP BY m.year
views.description: Aggregates per year to compute total movies and the percentage of movies that qualify as exclusively female based on associated actor genders.
